text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>... You truly are as great as<n>they come. I
can't help but stand in<n>awe.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I understand your frustration, Meek. I<n>really do.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But Trainer <username>, you and your trainee...<n>You've both
really inspired us!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I'll shine just as bright someday.<n>You'll see.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>, my role model and my rival...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We learned so much from them,<n>didn't we, Meek?
Trainer <username> really is<n>something else.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Yeah, and my rival racer was just as<n>cool.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
True, but don't forget how incredible<n>you were out
there. Watching how<n>your running has improved...
I've<n>really come to believe that the sky's<n>the limit.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I've cooked up some new strategies<n>for us, so I'll
be sure to run them by<n>Trainer <username> later to refine them.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. I'll try even<n>harder. Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I should be thanking you, Meek.<n>Let's keep aiming
for even greater<n>heights together!
